items.q: Which of these is a pure substance?
items.explain: Distilled water is one compound, H₂O, so it is a pure substance.
items.explainAf: Gedistilleerde water is een verbinding, H₂O, dus is dit ’n suiwer stof.

items.q: Which method separates salt from salt water?
items.qAf: Watter metode skei sout van soutwater?
items.explain: Evaporating the water leaves the salt behind as a solid.
items.explainAf: Deur die water te laat verdamp, bly die sout as ’n vastestof oor.

items.q: Which method separates sand from water?
items.qAf: Watter metode skei sand van water?
items.explain: Sand is insoluble and is caught by the filter paper, while the water passes through.
items.explainAf: Sand is onoplosbaar en word deur die filterpapier vasgevang, terwyl die water deurgaan.

items.q: Which of these is an element?
items.explain: O₂ contains only one type of atom (oxygen), so it is an element.
items.explainAf: O₂ bevat net een tipe atoom (suurstof), dus is dit ’n element.

items.q: How many atoms are in one molecule of glucose, C₆H₁₂O₆?
items.qAf: Hoeveel atome is in een molekule glukose, C₆H₁₂O₆?

items.q: How does a compound differ from a mixture?
options: A compound has a fixed composition and chemical bonds
A mixture has a fixed composition
A compound can be separated by filtration
optionsAf: ’n Verbinding het ’n vaste samestelling en chemiese bindings
’n Verbinding kan deur filtrasie geskei word
items.explain: A compound is chemically bonded in a fixed ratio; a mixture is not and can be separated physically.
items.explainAf: ’n Verbinding is chemies gebind in ’n vaste verhouding; ’n mengsel is nie en kan fisies geskei word nie.
